frontmatter_snapshot.summary: The Marchenko-Pastur law gives the limiting eigenvalue density of a white-Wishart sample covariance matrix with spectral edges (1±√q)² and a (q-1)/q delta-mass for q>1, derived from a self-consistent Stieltjes equation, per Potters & Bouchaud Ch.4.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Marchenko-Pastur Law: The Null Spectrum of a Sample Covariance Matrix
